assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: a compact academic concept plate inside an advanced reinforcement-learning textbook, NOT a cover image.
Visual system: high-resolution landscape 3:2 composition, ideally 1536 by 1024 pixels; opaque warm-white paper #fffaf2, charcoal text, restrained terracotta #b56746, pale taupe and muted slate accents. Flat two-dimensional vector-like raster shapes, thin consistent rules, generous internal padding, no ornamental gradients, no realistic people, no robots, no decoration. Elegant academic editorial layout, subtle icons only when they explain a mechanism.
Typography: crisp generously sized English labels, verbatim as requested; short heading and short labels only. Keep all text comfortably inside the canvas.
Scientific boundary: conceptual grouping and sparse broad information/learning arrows only. Do not create exact equations, numerical axes, measurements, performance charts, tensor dimensions or engineering wiring. All precise mathematical relationships are typeset outside this image. No safety guarantees, no industrial performance claims.
Avoid long single-row or single-column chains, dense crossing wires, tiny text, redundant arrows, watermarks and logos.

Heading: "INTERACTION & LEARNING".
Create four well-spaced illustrated stations in a balanced clockwise loop, arranged as a compact square: upper left "Observe" with a small sensor/observation card, upper right "Choose action" with a small decision token, lower right "Process response" with a modest abstract dynamic-process motif, lower left "Reward & new observation" with two feedback cards. Use exactly four short curved arrows around this loop; reward and next observation clearly arrive after the process response. A quiet central label reads "One decision step".
Below the loop, a shallow separate grouping labeled "Recorded experience" shows a stack of trajectory cards beside a small learning notebook, not a direct live-control connection. Beside it use two small distinct boundary badges, "True end" and "Time limit". They must look distinct, not equivalent; no claim that learning occurs only when an episode ends. No additional text. Focus on a repeated interaction cycle and experience, not a long sequential flowchart.
inspection_notes: Inspected the generated PNG inline and the saved WebP with view_image. All requested English labels are legible and remain inside the canvas.
The compact clockwise cycle runs Observe → Choose action → Process response → Reward & new observation; reward is visibly after the action's process response.

Recorded experience is a separate learning grouping. True end and Time limit use distinct labelled badges; the picture does not claim that a time limit is a true terminal state or that learning occurs only on episode termination.
No equations, numeric axes, purported measured data or industrial control-authority claims appear. The two small gear arrows are an abstract dynamics icon rather than engineering wiring.
